'''Tusken King''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] used by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The position of [[King/Legends|King]] was assumed amongst a number of Tusken Raiders, but the most well known was the [[Tusken King]] who fought and [[Death/Legends|died]] in the [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|Invasion of Mos Espa]].

==History==
[[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] were originally known as Sand People until their ruthless attack on [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]] around a [[95 BBY|century before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:NoT">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67431&month=092007|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Nomads of Tatooine}}</ref>

During more ancient times, a Tusken King plagued [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine's]] first settlers.<ref name="SWG:TKR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Tusken King's Rifle}}</ref> Nevertheless, the existence of Tusken Kings was not confirmed until the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and remained to the state of rumor for a long time. It was said that the Tusken King was the proudest and strongest of all the Sand People, leading his people in their attacks and officiating in their sacred rituals.<ref name="SWG:NoT" />

A number of Tusken Kings were known to rule the Sand People during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Civil War following the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="SWG:TN">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Tolan Nokkar|Tatooine}}</ref> One, and perhaps the most famous example, included the [[Tusken King]] who launched an invasion of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]],<ref name="SWG:TA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=heroic|Tusken Army}}</ref> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> but died in the ensuing [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|battle]]. This Tusken King wore a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon skull]] [[Rucksack of the Tusken King|rucksack]], and clothing radically different than most Tusken Raiders.<ref name="SWG:TA" />

However, at least one other Tusken Raiders was known to assume the rank of King on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around this same time period. A Tusken King and a group of fellow Sand People overtook a [[Tusken Village|village]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the escaped citizen [[Tolan Nokkar]] employed a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who liberated the [[City/Legends|village]] by wiping out the Tuskens and their King.<ref name="SWG:TN" /> The same year, a Tusken King, possibly the same than the one aforementioned, led a group of Sand People to overtake an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Tusken Bunker|bunker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="SWG:TB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Tusken Bunker|Tatooine}}</ref> Unlike the Tusken King who fought in the Invasion of Mos Espa, this or these Kings wore garbs indistinguishable from other Tusken Raiders.<ref name="SWG:TN" /><ref name="SWG:TB" />
